_doc: Prices and shops (AD-22, story 10.1), in integer cents. Item types: 'vehicle' unlocks `vehicle` through shop.buyVehicle; 'snack' refills stamina to `stamina` (0..1) of the bar; 'cosmetic' is worn in `slot` (hat above the head, ring under the feet) by whoever bought it and is put on straight away, owned cosmetics can be changed in the shop; 'upgrade' is a permanent family upgrade (`key: ammo` adds `bonus` to the slingshot magazine); 'ticket' is a day pass that makes every tram ride of today free. `shops` lists what each map shop sells (the map object's `shopId`, the bakery sells `bakery`); names and descriptions are i18n keys item.<id>.name / item.<id>.desc and shop.<id>.name.
